ideas.title: Investigating Federal Investigations
ideas.description: This story would investigate the various federal investigations underway, including the investigation into North Side home explosions and the investigation into the rice industry.
questions: What are the causes of the North Side home explosions?
What is the scope of the federal investigation into the rice industry?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and corruption. By investigating these federal investigations, we can shed light on the need for increased scrutiny and oversight.
